statement: A delegated implementation leaf salvaging a committed prior slice ran git cherry-pick on the salvage commit instead of extracting files, leaving a conflicted cherry-pick in the shared checkout; git cherry-pick --abort restored the tree without losing other lanes' in-flight edits.
why: Salvage instructions said extract FILES via git show, never merge/cherry-pick; the leaf (or a forbidden sub-leaf) took the shortcut anyway. Conflicted state reverted ids.rs and staged stale files.
howToApply: When spawning implementation agents into a shared checkout, state git prohibitions as hard rules AND verify git status immediately after delegation starts; abort any merge/cherry-pick state before continuing; back up conflicted versions to scratchpad before aborting.
